note: RDR2 shop prices vary by honour level (up to ±25%). High honour = discounts at general stores and gunsmiths. Low honour = discounts at fences (black market). This honour-based pricing mechanic is a strong GTA VI prediction input.

honour_price_modifier.note: Low honour gives discounts at FENCES only, not regular stores. Very low honour = 25% discount at fence. Very high honour = 25% discount at stores.

gta_vi_implication: If GTA VI adopts an honour/reputation system, NPC shop prices will diverge by protagonist behaviour. Models for this are in data/gta-6/predictions.json (pred-rdr2-honour-pricing).
